content: वत्सः [वद्-सः <ls>Uṇ. 3. 61</ls>] .²1 A calf, the young of an animal; तेनाद्य वत्समिव लोकममुं पुषाण <ls>Bh. 2. 46</ls>; यं सर्वशैलाः परिकल्प्य वत्सम् <ls>Ku. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 A boy, son; in this sense often used in the <ab>voc.</ab> as a term of endearment and translatable by ‘my dear’, ‘my darling’, ‘my dear child’; अयि वत्स कृतं कृतमतिविनयेन, किमपराद्धं वत्सेन <ls>U. 6</ls>. .²3 Offspring or children in general; जीवद्वत्सा ‘one whose children are living’. .²4 A year. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a country; (its chief town was कौशाम्बी and ruled over by Udayana), or the inhabitants of that country (<ab>pl.</ab>). .{@-त्सा@} .²1 A female calf. .²2 A little girl; वत्से सीते ‘dear Sītā’ <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-त्सम्@} The breast.
